title: HIT STOP AND THE LANCE KICK
why: His order: "hit stop to enemies - do minor player knock back on using the meridian lance". A round that landed changed nothing about the body it hit, so a heavy hit felt like a pistol tap. Now a heavy round, 40 damage or more (the Magnum, the Marksman Rifle, the Longshot, the Meridian Lance), stops the body it hits for a sixtieth of a second: it neither walks nor shoots for that beat. A body the round kills is not held, a boss is never held, and a light round does nothing. The Meridian Lance also shoves you back a short step along the shot when you fire it, through the walls push-out, so it never puts you into one. Nothing draws from the seeded stream and the bot raids are untouched.
now: Heavy rounds stop what they hit for a beat, and the Meridian Lance kicks you back a step.
